title: Anduril Sparrows Point primary-record status
summary: A fresh primary-source and current-news review did not recover a public Anduril lease, project-specific incentive approval, or first-party announcement converting the reported Sparrows Point MOU discussions into an approved or operational facility. Tradepoint Atlantic's current public office/corporate address remains site-owner geography, not an Anduril facility address.

sources.title: Anduril Weighs Baltimore Shipyard Investment to Build Drone Boats

data.question: Has public primary evidence converted Anduril's reported Sparrows Point MOU discussions into a lease, project-specific incentive award, construction commitment, or operational facility?
findings: Tradepoint Atlantic currently publishes 6995 Bethlehem Blvd, Suite 100, Sparrows Point, MD 21219 as its office/corporate address.
Tradepoint Atlantic separately publishes site gates, warehouses, and terminal locations; none reviewed is identified as an Anduril facility.
Tradepoint Atlantic describes site-wide Enterprise Zone and Foreign Trade Zone status, but no reviewed primary record makes those conditions an Anduril-specific incentive award.
Current reporting continues to describe an MOU and advanced discussions while stating that a final lease had not been signed.

No reviewed Anduril, Tradepoint Atlantic, Maryland government, or Baltimore County primary source publicly establishes an executed Anduril lease or operational Sparrows Point facility as of this pass.
